text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—Gyaaaaaah!!??
A bug!! Where did it come from?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Silence! How dare you raid my sleeping quarters, you impudent scoundrel!
Unless thou desirest to become rust upon this blade,
begone at once! Begoooone!!!!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
“...... W-What's the deal here... hey!?
Are you leaving or not... !?”

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
And so, I spent the whole night wrestling with that thing...
...*yaaaawn*.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: No Reason looked sleep-deprived because a bug refused to leave his room.
